visualization.notes: Trials started slowly with 10 in 2013, increasing steadily to a peak of 107 in 2022. After 2022, trial counts decline, with only 2 trials starting in 2027. Note that data for years beyond 2024 may be incomplete or projected.
visualization.query_interpretation: User requests a time trend for Pembrolizumab trials. Using query_intr for the drug, grouping by year of start date to show how trial count changes over time.
